cards.ex: We need to shift gears and focus on marketing if we want to increase sales.
cards.exUz: Agar sotuvni oshirmoqchi bo'lsak, yo'nalishni o'zgartirib, marketingga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ish uslubini yoki yondashuvni keskin o'zgartirish, yangi usulga o'tish.

cards.ex: The new policy is finally gaining traction among employees.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat, nihoyat, xodimlar orasida ommaviylashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'oya yoki mahsulot tobora ko'proq odamlar tomonidan qabul qilinishi.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep pace with all the technological advancements.
cards.exUz: Barcha texnologik yutuqlar bilan hamnafas bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Tez o'zgarish yoki rivojlanishga moslashish, orqada qolmaslik.

cards.ex: There are some exciting new developments on the horizon for the company.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya uchun ufqda bir nechta qiziqarli yangi o'zgarishlar ko'rinmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin orada bo'ladigan, kutilayotgan o'zgarish yoki voqea.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, she's finally reaping the benefits of her investment.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mehnatdan so'ng, u nihoyat o'z sarmoyasining foydasini ko'rmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan harakatlar natijasida foyda yoki yutuqlarga erishish.

cards.ex: Success is within a stone's throw away if you keep pushing yourself.
cards.exUz: Agar o'zingizni rag'batlantirishda davom etsangiz, muvaffaqiyat qo'l yetmas joyda.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofada joylashgan, tezda erishish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The new regulations raise the bar for environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha talabni oshiradi.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarni yoki talablarni yuqoriroq darajaga ko'tarish.

cards.ex: His innovative ideas were a breath of fresh air in the stagnant industry.
cards.exUz: Uning innovatsion g'oyalari turg'un sanoatda yangi nafas edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, tetiklantiruvchi va foydali o'zgarish.

cards.ex: She's determined to climb the ladder and become CEO.
cards.exUz: U martaba pillapoyasidan ko'tarilib, bosh direktor bo'lishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida yuqori lavozimlarga erishish, martabada o'sish.

cards.ex: He's on the fast track to becoming a partner at the law firm.
cards.exUz: U yuridik firmada sherik bo'lish uchun tez yo'lda.
cards.uzDef: Tez rivojlanayotgan, muvaffaqiyatga tez erishish yo'lida bo'lgan.

cards.ex: It's time for out with the old, in with the new, and embrace the future.
cards.exUz: Eskisi bilan xayrlashuv, yangisini qabul qilish va kelajakni qabul qilish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Eskisini tashlab, yangisini qabul qilish, o'zgarishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new technology represents a step change in manufacturing efficiency.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya ishlab chiqarish samaradorligida keskin o'zgarishni anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va sezilarli o'zgarish, oldingi holatdan sezilarli farq.

cards.ex: The new advertising campaign helped to turn the tide for the company.
cards.exUz: Yangi reklama kampaniyasi kompaniya uchun vaziyatni o'zgartirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni yaxshi tomonga o'zgartirish, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: The project is finally gaining momentum after a slow start.
cards.exUz: Loyiha sekin boshlanganidan keyin nihoyat tezlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Harakat yoki jarayonning tezligi va kuchi ortishi.

cards.ex: Her research paved the way for new treatments for the disease.
cards.exUz: Uning tadqiqotlari kasallikni davolashning yangi usullari uchun yo'l ochdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi o'zgarishlar yoki rivojlanishlar uchun sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: We need to move forward with the project despite the challenges.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, biz loyiha bilan oldinga siljishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish, yaxshilanish tomon harakat qilish, o'zgarishga intilish.

cards.ex: He brought a fresh perspective to the team, which helped us solve the problem.
cards.exUz: U jamoaga yangi nuqtai nazar olib keldi, bu bizga muammoni hal qilishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarga yoki muammolarga yangicha qarash.

cards.ex: You need to work hard if you want to get ahead in this industry.
cards.exUz: Agar ushbu sohada o'zib ketmoqchi bo'lsangiz, ko'p ishlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra muvaffaqiyatliroq bo'lish, rivojlanish.

cards.ex: In the business world, it's adapt or die; you can't stay stagnant.
cards.exUz: Biznes olamida moslash yoki o'l; siz turg'un bo'lib qola olmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishlarga moslashmaslik muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib keladi.

cards.ex: We've had some setbacks, but it's onwards and upwards from here.
cards.exUz: Bizda ba'zi kamchiliklar bor edi, lekin bundan buyon oldinga va yuqoriga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanishga va muvaffaqiyatga erishishga intilish.

cards.ex: The new training program is starting to take root in the company.
cards.exUz: Yangi trening dasturi kompaniyada ildiz ota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: G'oya, odat yoki tizimning mustahkam o'rnashishi, rivojlanishi.

cards.ex: The internet caused a paradigm shift in the way we communicate.
cards.exUz: Internet bizning aloqa uslubimizda paradigma o'zgarishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Dunyoni tushunish va fikrlash usulida tubdan o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The scientist's research broke new ground in the field of genetics.
cards.exUz: Olimning tadqiqotlari genetika sohasida yangi yo'l ochdi.
cards.uzDef: Avval hech kim qilmagan yangi narsa yaratish, yangi sohada ishlash.

cards.ex: The decrease in crime rates is a positive development for the city.
cards.exUz: Jinoyat darajasining pasayishi shahar uchun ijobiy o'zgarishdir.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi natijalarga olib keladigan o'zgarish.

cards.ex: We need to rethink our strategy if we want to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Agar raqobatbardosh bo'lishni istasak, strategiyamizni qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejalarni o'zgartirish, yangi yondashuvlar qidirish.

cards.ex: Investing in education pays off in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda o'z samarasini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt o'tgach.

cards.ex: The new leader was a catalyst for change in the organization.
cards.exUz: Yangi rahbar tashkilotda o'zgarish katalizatori bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishni tezlashtiradigan yoki boshlaydigan narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: We need to redefine success to include more than just financial gain.
cards.exUz: Biz muvaffaqiyatni faqat moliyaviy foydadan ko'proq narsani o'z ichiga olishi uchun qayta ta'riflashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyat haqidagi tushunchani o'zgartirish, yangi mezonlar belgilash.

cards.ex: If this approach isn't working, we need to take a different tack.
cards.exUz: Agar bu yondashuv ishlamayotgan bo'lsa, biz boshqa yo'lni tutishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoga yechim topishning boshqa usulini qo'llash.

cards.ex: A shift in mindset is needed to overcome these challenges.
cards.exUz: Ushbu qiyinchiliklarni yengish uchun fikrlash o'zgarishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'ylash usulida sezilarli o'zgarish, yangicha qarash.
